title: Search box loses focus after typing one letter
body: When typing in the notes search, the input loses focus after every keystroke. The `SearchInput` component in `src/components/SearchInput.jsx` probably re-mounts on each render. Steps: open the app and type "abc".

title: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page
body: Users asked for a dark theme. Add a toggle in `src/pages/Settings.jsx` and store the choice in localStorage.

title: Typo in the README install section
body: The README says "npm instal". Please fix it in `README.md`. It is a one-line change.

title: Lexer crashes on empty input
body: Calling `tokenize("")` in `src/lexer.ts` throws "Cannot read properties of undefined". It should return an empty list.

title: Add unit tests for the tokenizer
body: There are no tests for the tokenizer. Add a few cases in `tests/tokenizer.test.ts` for numbers, strings and operators.

title: Document the grammar in docs/grammar.md
body: The grammar only exists in our heads. Write it down in `docs/grammar.md` with two or three examples.

title: CSV reader fails on files with a BOM
body: Files saved by Excel start with a byte order mark and the first column name is garbled. See `wrangler/readers/csv.py`.

title: Add a --version flag to the CLI
body: Running `wrangler --version` should print the package version. The argument parser is in `wrangler/cli.py`.

title: Show a progress bar for large files
body: Converting a 1 GB file looks frozen. Show progress while reading. Check `wrangler/convert.py`.

title: Planner crashes when two classes overlap
body: Adding two classes at the same time raises a KeyError in `planner/schedule.py`. We should show a friendly warning instead.

title: Add Hindi translation for the UI strings
body: Copy `locales/en.json` to `locales/hi.json` and translate the values. No coding needed.

title: Update CONTRIBUTING.md with setup steps
body: The repo has no CONTRIBUTING file. Add one with setup, test and PR steps.

title: Support an --ignore-case flag
body: Add `-i` so the search ignores letter case. Argument handling lives in `src/main.rs`.

title: Colorize matches in the output
body: Highlight the matched text in red when printing. See `src/output.rs`.

title: Panic on a file with invalid UTF-8
body: Running against a binary file panics in `src/reader.rs`. It should skip the file with a warning.

title: Add retry with backoff to the worker
body: Failed jobs are dropped. Retry up to three times with growing delays in `worker/retry.go`.

title: Improve the error message when the queue is full
body: The message "error 17" is not helpful. Return a clear text from `queue/queue.go`.

title: Add a Makefile target for tests
body: Add `make test` that runs `go test ./...`. Edit the `Makefile`.

title: Button component is missing an aria-label
body: Icon-only buttons are not announced by screen readers. Fix `src/Button.jsx`.

title: Tooltip flickers on hover
body: Moving the mouse slowly over the edge makes the tooltip blink. Look at `src/Tooltip.jsx`.

title: Add a Storybook story for Badge
body: The Badge component has no story. Add `src/Badge.stories.jsx`.

title: Modal should close when Escape is pressed
body: Listen for the Escape key in `src/Modal.jsx` and call `onClose`.

title: Migrate old blog posts to Markdown
body: Posts are stored as HTML. Write a small script that converts them to `.md` files.

title: Broken link in the footer
body: The "About" link in `templates/footer.html` points to a page that does not exist.

title: Add a cheat sheet for list comprehensions
body: Create `sheets/lists.md` with five short examples and when to use them.

title: Fix the formatting of the dict cheat sheet table
body: The table in `sheets/dicts.md` is broken on GitHub. Fix the pipes and header row.

title: Add examples for f-strings
body: Show padding, number formatting and dates in `sheets/strings.md`.

title: Card hover animation is jerky
body: The hover effect in `css/cards.css` jumps on Firefox. Try using `transform` instead of `margin`.

title: Add dark palette variables
body: Create dark-theme custom properties in `css/tokens.css`.

title: Contrast is too low on footer links
body: Footer links are light grey on white. Make them pass WCAG AA in `css/footer.css`.
